description: Six defects that leave no mechanical signature: a join on an effective date rather than an availability date, a label sharing a bar with its features, a date-less reference table applied across history, an entity-grouped split with no time constraint, order sizing with no volume check, and a holdout queried five times. The static layer must find nothing here; every expectation is an LM-only check.

expected.note: The join uses the effective date instead of the availability date.
Label and feature are drawn from the same bar's open.
A one-row-per-ticker reference table applied across all of history.
Splitting by entity leaves the time axis completely unconstrained.
Order size is never checked against traded volume.
The same holdout is queried across five rounds of revision.
